Title: Azure Applied AI Services | Azure Video Analyzer updates in public preview

Body.Content:
Azure Video Analyzer now offers new cloud-based capabilities in preview to capture, record, and watch streamed videos from cameras that are connected to the cloud either directly, or through a gateway device. In addition, you can export and download portions of recorded video.

Learn more in this TechCommunity blog.
